body:
**Pathfinders' Survival** 是一个专注于提供**原版《我的世界》生存体验**的服务器，旨在通过技术优化和社区共建，打造纯净、稳定且包容的沙盒环境。服务器基于 Purpur 核心（Paper 的高性能分支），支持 Minecraft **1.21.11** 版本，并向下**兼容 1.16.5** 以上版本，覆盖超过 95% 的玩家群体。我们坚持**保留 Mojang 原版机制**，玩家可自由建造复杂红石装置、探索随机生成的地形，并专注于生存挑战，无插件干扰或规则篡改。
技术与稳定性：服务器采用 中国联通公网 线路，提供 100Mbps 上行 与 1Gbps 下行带宽，保障全球玩家低延迟连接。系统每 15 分钟自动存档，并通过阿里云 OSS 实现异地备份，防止数据丢失。安全机制包括轻量级反作弊插件（如 CoreProtect、NoCheatPlus），仅检测外挂行为，同时符合欧盟 GDPR 及中国《个人信息保护法》（PIPL）的数据隐私要求。
**社区与规则**：我们倡导**公平、包容与透明**的社区文化。禁止任何形式的骚扰、歧视或现实货币交易（RMT），所有资源交换需通过游戏内完成。玩家可通过 [QQ群](https://qm.qq.com/q/uyOK4Fmhxu)/[Discord](https://discord.gg/Tjh523wYvy)参与规则讨论，管理团队定期公开更新决策。未来计划包括扩展历史版本支持（如 1.12.2），举办红石/建筑竞赛

**Pathfinders' Survival** is a dedicated **Minecraft vanilla survival** server designed to deliver an authentic, unaltered gameplay experience while ensuring technical stability and community-driven governance. Built on the Purpur core (a high-performance fork of Paper), the server **supports Minecraft 1.21.11** and maintains backward compatibility with versions **from 1.16.5 onward**, accommodating over 95% of the player base. Our philosophy centers on preserving the **integrity of Mojang’s original mechanics**: players can freely construct complex redstone machines, explore procedurally generated biomes, and engage in survival challenges without interference from disruptive plugins or rule modifications.
To ensure seamless connectivity, the server operates on China Unicom’s public network with 100Mbps upload and 1Gbps download speeds, minimizing latency for global players. Automated backups occur every 15 minutes, and data is redundantly stored on Alibaba Cloud OSS to prevent loss. Security measures include lightweight anti-cheat plugins (e.g., CoreProtect, NoCheatPlus) that detect exploits without infringing on player privacy, aligning with GDPR and China’s Personal Information Protection Law (PIPL).
**Community guidelines emphasize fair play**, **inclusivity, and transparency**. Harassment, discrimination, and real-money trading (RMT) are strictly prohibited. Players collaborate through [Discord](https://discord.gg/Tjh523wYvy) to shape server rules, and updates are publicly documented. Future plans include expanding version support (e.g., 1.12.2) and hosting redstone/building competitions.
This project adheres strictly to legal and ethical standards: no content violates intellectual property rights, promotes harmful behavior, or breaches privacy laws. All systems prioritize player autonomy, technical excellence, and a return to Minecraft’s core essence—exploration, creation, and survival in a blocky, boundless world.
